Aero 1.3.2: Aero's own window and title bar, projects, a Files view, and settings that keep your edits.

## Install or update

Aero 1.0 to 1.3.1 offer this update at startup (**Update now**). New installs:

| System | File | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Windows** 10 / 11 (64-bit) | `Aero-windows.zip` | Extract it, double-click `Update-Aero.bat`, accept the admin prompt. `--dest D:\Aero` installs elsewhere; `--lean` skips setting up the integrations now (Aero finishes them in the background). |
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon or Intel) | `Aero-macos.zip` | Unzip it, right-click `Install-Aero.command` → Open. |
| **Linux**, any distro | `install.sh` | `curl -fsSL https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/releases/latest/download/install.sh \| sh` |
| Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS | `aero_1.3.2_all.deb` | `sudo apt install ./aero_1.3.2_all.deb` |
| Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, Alma, openSUSE | `aero-1.3.2-1.noarch.rpm` | `sudo dnf install ./aero-1.3.2-1.noarch.rpm` |
| Arch, Manjaro, EndeavourOS | `PKGBUILD` | `makepkg -si` |
| Any Linux, by hand | `Aero-linux.tar.gz` | `sh Aero/install.sh` |

Models, chats, memory, settings, keys, tunings, skills and mods carry over.

## New

- **Aero's own window (Windows).** The Windows title bar is gone. Aero's header has the sidebar button, the
  project, the Chat / Files / Changes views and minimize / maximize / close. Drag it to move the window (Snap
  works), double-click to maximize; the edges resize. Needs WebView2 (part of Windows 11 and Edge); otherwise Aero
  opens in Edge or Chrome as before.
- **Projects.** A folder with its own instructions. Chats in a project work in that folder, follow its
  instructions and are grouped under it in the sidebar.
- **Files.** Browse the project's folder: code with colours and line numbers, Markdown, images, PDFs.
- **Changes.** Every file the chat wrote, moved or deleted, with each edit as a diff.

## Fixed

- **Settings** keep your edits when you switch tabs, and one Save saves every tab. The window is one size on every
  tab, the tab list stays put and only the settings scroll. Unsaved tabs are marked, and closing with unsaved
  changes asks first.

Full list: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/blob/main/source/CHANGELOG.md).
